mechanism: Betamethasone may increase amitriptyline levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and increase anticholinergic/CNS effects; amitriptyline may mask signs of infection due to betamethasone immunosuppression.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic side effects and signs of infection; consider amitriptyline dose reduction if adverse effects emerge; use betamethasone at lowest effective dose.
